water_bottle_omar: I assumed dish_rack_k1 based on previous evening patterns, but at 19:49 it was at kitchen_table_k1. Pattern: Location is highly variable in the evening, switching between the table and dish rack. Do not assume a fixed spot; check both kitchen_table_k1 and dish_rack_k1.

mug_omar: I previously noted kitchen_table_k1 for mornings, but at 21:17 and 21:52 it was at cupboard_k1. Pattern: In the evening, the mug is stored in the cupboard, not on the table or in the living room. Check cupboard_k1 for evening queries.

charger_omar: I assumed entry_hook_e1 for night based on previous notes, but at 22:19 it was at nightstand_b1. Pattern: The charger moves to the bedroom at night. Check nightstand_b1 for late evening/night queries; do not assume entry_hook_e1.

glass_omar: I previously noted cupboard_k1 for evening, but at 22:19 it was at nightstand_b1. Pattern: Like the charger, the glass moves to the bedroom at night. Check nightstand_b1 for late evening/night queries; do not assume cupboard_k1 or kitchen_table_k1.

razor_omar: I assumed sink_ba_ba1, but it was at bathroom_shelf_ba1. Pattern: Razors are stored on the shelf, not the sink. Check bathroom_shelf_ba1 for all queries.

glasses_omar: I previously noted bathroom_shelf_ba1 for mornings, but at 21:12 it was at coffee_table_l1. Pattern: Location is not fixed to the bathroom or bedroom. Check coffee_table_l1 for evening queries; do not assume bathroom_shelf_ba1 or bed_b1.

book_omar: Previous note indicated bed_b1 for evening. No new errors today, so this pattern remains relevant. Check bed_b1.

General: Evening locations are dynamic. Kitchen items (mug, glass) and personal items (charger) often move to the bedroom (nightstand) or cupboard late in the evening. Do not rely on daytime or early evening locations for late-night queries. Always check the specific recent feedback locations for these items.
